utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is the repair drive still on for next Saturday? I need a solid yes before I can bring my tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Next Saturday? Oh, I think so—but I can't quite recall if we settled on that. Did we?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Well, can you check with whoever's organizing it? I don't want to haul my gear over for nothing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Hana! I've been hearing bits about the repair drive—what's the scoop on what they're collecting?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Nell! From what Noah told me, it sounds like we're mainly collecting to fix up the old playground equipment in the park—specifically that broken swing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that makes sense—the swing's been busted for ages. I've got some old paint cans in the garage, think they'd want those?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I've got three so far, but I'm worried that's not enough to handle the workload if Leo's fence is as bad as I think it is.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so you're actually signing up to help with Leo's fence? I thought that was just neighborhood gossip.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It's not gossip, Kira. I saw the state of his fence last week—it's practically leaning into his yard. If we don't act soon, it's going to be a bigger headache for all of us.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just a heads-up, Dane—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, Sunday? Got it, thanks. And wait—are we still doing the fence or is it all random repairs now?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually, I think it's all random repairs now—the flyer didn't mention the fence specifically.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, Eli! Just a heads up, the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday? That's a change from what Vik said about Saturday at his place. Can you confirm that's definite?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's definite—I got the update directly from the organizers, so Sunday at the community center is the plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, just a heads-up—the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on my porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh thanks for letting me know, Jules. I'll make sure to bring my tools over Sunday instead.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, see you there! I think we'll have a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Noah! The repair drive is this Saturday at 10. We're focusing on the park swing set and a few benches—stuff the neighborhood has been wanting fixed for a while.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the swing set! I knew it was something like that. Saturday at 10—got it, I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, glad you're on board! I'll add you to my list— and if you have any extra tools, bring 'em along, Cleo's bringing her whole toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, is it this weekend or just today? I'm losing track.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: This Saturday, same thing I told Quinn. Noon start, couple hours tops.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, Saturday noon at Oak Street—got it. I'll swing by but can't stay long.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure, Sam! Let's sort through them now—I'd love to see what we have for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, so it's settled for Sunday then. I'll double-check my wrenches and screwdrivers to be ready.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo! That'll be a huge help. Let's make this a great day for the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? They're fixing up old stuff and even sprucing up the playground—want to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I sure have, Tess! I'll be there around noon—want to come with me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great idea! I'll meet you at your place a little before noon then—we can walk over together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Uli, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? They're fixing up old bikes and appliances at the community center on Oak Street!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I heard. Might bring in my old toaster if I can manage to carry it over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, bring it! I heard they even have experts for electronics, so that toaster should be no problem.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Ira, are you heading to the repair drive too? Mina was curious about it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center now — not Saturday on the porch like they first said.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, Sunday at the community center? That's good to know — I'll let Mina know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Ira, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? They need old appliances and volunteers!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Actually, I heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center. Still need volunteers though!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wait, Sunday? I've been telling everyone it's Saturday! I better spread the word before people show up on the wrong day.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can pick up the screws and brackets on Friday, if that works.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Friday works. Just remember the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday at the community center, got it. I'll still grab the screws and brackets on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli! So glad to catch you — just wanted to let you know the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, that's a relief, Rosa — I was worried about the schedule mix-up. So it's Sunday at the community center? I'll mark it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, that's right! I'm so glad it works for you — your help is always appreciated.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mara, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I've been getting bits and pieces from everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I've been spreading the word! Are you planning to come? I'll be there around noon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's great! I'd love to come, but I'm still a little fuzzy on what we're actually doing—could you fill me in?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, the repair drive. Sounds like a quick job if we start early. I'll be ready with my gear by 9.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, 9 works for me. I'll grab my toolbox and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, see you then. I'll try not to be late.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! That's the thing where we fix up old stuff, isn't it? I think I have a broken toaster somewhere...

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's perfect, Oren! Bring that toaster along—we'll have folks who can fix it. Everyone's meeting at the community center this Saturday, so don't forget!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday, you say? I'll try to remember that... I might need a reminder though, my memory's been like a sieve lately.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Gus! Did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center? I'm still planning to bring my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I heard! Sunday works better for me too. Thanks for bringing your toolbox, Cleo—we'll put it to good use.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, glad it works for you! I'll make sure to pack those spare screws too—you never know what might need a quick fix.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Rey! I've got some tools set aside in the garage. Want to come over and help me sort through them?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good, Sam. I can come by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, I'll be in the garage. Just knock when you get here—I'll have the coffee ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Leo, just a heads up—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, Sunday works better anyway. I'll bring my tool kit.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Leo! I think Jules and Opal will be there too, so it should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the repair drive is this weekend! We're meeting at my place at 10, then heading over to fix Mrs. Chen's fence—don't forget your toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait—Noah mentioned playground equipment, not a fence. Are we doing both, or did something change?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, I think it's just the fence for now—Mrs. Chen's fence. But maybe we can do the playground next time? Let's stick to the plan: my place at 10, tools for the fence!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I'm pretty sure it's just the playground stuff. I don't remember hearing about anything at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So just the playground swing, not the community center? You're certain about that?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, pretty sure. I mean, I could be wrong—I kind of zone out during those planning meetings.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, so five confirmed plus Vik's crew—think that'll be enough to handle all the broken-down bikes and that old dresser Mrs. Henson dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think we'll manage, especially now that it's at the community center—more room and tools!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: The community center's got better lighting too—did you check if the power tools are all working?
